snippet.title: Threaded Dungeons Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

Threaded Dungeons is a party-based, turn-based dungeon crawler RPG. 

Play the demo:
On Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559620/

On Itch:
https://liveriver.itch.io/threaded-dungeons-demo-webgl

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461810/
